author: go0by
body:
I was warned for spamming by LFT. I know he meant no harm (as a Junior Mod he is trying to enforce the rules), but I was in no way spamming. I didn't intend to spam, I never even did much spam. I said an actual, comprehensible phrase, but it was split up into a couple of messages. I know it is just a warn, but I feel it is wrong and should be removed, I can't afford to have any more infractions.

Thank you.

I don't have a screenshot, but I'm sure you can check the chat logs. I was actually trying to help a player avoid getting a temp ban / ban for racism with what I was saying.
